local util_cargo = require('Module:CargoUtil')
local rows = util_cargo.query{
	tables = 'Items=I, Locales=L',
	join = 'I.Item = L.Entity',
	fields = 'I._pageName=page, I.Rarity=rarity, I.Type=type, GROUP_CONCAT(L.Param, ":::", L.Value, ";;;" SEPARATOR "")=locales',
	where = 'L.Lang="en"',
	groupBy = 'I.Item',
}
local data = {}
for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
	local item = {}
	item.page = row.page
	item.rarity = tonumber(row.rarity)
	item.type = row.type
	for k, v in row.locales:gmatch('(.-):::(.-);;;') do
		item[k] = v
	end
	data[item.name] = item
end
return data
